title: task-family history survives A/B model-replacement context recovery
implementation: Exercise create_from_admitted_history with an actual task-family record admitted through normal cognition/writeback; bind it to the frozen A/B history context and verify the same source is present/withheld/restored as specified.
positive_control: Both fixture model endpoints receive the same exact admitted family record in present/restored conditions; current evidence is separate and withheld conditions have empty history.
negative_control: Read-only child process verifies exact persistent context IDs/digests; re-instantiated replacement owner recovers the completed run without any new endpoint inference.
